verdict.rationale: Evidence pack shows a REST/JSON API (v3), sandbox mode, idempotency keys, and webhooks, but there is no mention of API versioning strategy, version numbers beyond 'v3' in the URL, or any documented deprecation policy/timeline; probes also confirm no OpenAPI spec or docs.md found. Missing for 10: explicit version-numbering scheme, changelog, deprecation notice process, sunset timelines for old API versions.
